description: This file defines the TextResponse class, a specialized HTTP response class for plain text content within the Laminas Diactoros library. It provides mechanisms to create text responses with proper headers and stream handling.

classes.name: TextResponse
classes.description: A response class for sending plain text content, sets default headers and content type, extends the Response base class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a plain text HTTP response with optional status and headers.

methods.name: createBody
methods.description: Creates a StreamInterface body for the response from a string or stream.
